t: Any project heretofore authorized by any Act of Congress, insofar as such project relates to the above-described portion of the Brewery Street section of New Haven Harbor, is hereby abandoned.

fable.w: This section simply declares that previously authorized projects relating to a portion of New Haven Harbor are abandoned by act of Congress. A tempting reading is that abandoning a harbor project affects local interests and so implies consultation, but the text provides no hearing, comment, consultation, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government.

qwen_block.w: This section simply declares that a previously authorized project is abandoned. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government (such as states, tribes, or the public) before making this decision. The action is a unilateral legislative or administrative termination of a project.
qwen_block.s: Any project heretofore authorized by any Act of Congress, insofar as such project relates to the above-described portion of the Brewery Street section of New Haven Harbor, is hereby abandoned.

opus.w: Congress itself abandons previously authorized projects for one part of a harbor. Nothing requires or allows consultation, hearings, comment, advisory input or lawsuits by anyone outside the federal government. Calling it participation because it is a decision about a local harbor would be wrong, because no outside party is involved in making that decision.
opus.s: Any project heretofore authorized by any Act of Congress, insofar as such project relates to the above-described portion of the Brewery Street section of New Haven Harbor, is hereby abandoned.

qwen_chat.w: This section simply declares that a previously authorized project is abandoned. It does not require or recommend any consultation, coordination, or participation with parties outside the federal government. The action is a unilateral legislative directive to terminate a project, not a process involving external stakeholders.
qwen_chat.s: Any project heretofore authorized by any Act of Congress, insofar as such project relates to the above-described portion of the Brewery Street section of New Haven Harbor, is hereby abandoned.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that abandoning a project is a "decision" and therefore any prior process involved participation. However, the text itself does not describe any participation process; it simply states the outcome (abandonment). There is no mention of consulting with outsiders, holding hearings, or allowing public comment in this specific section.
